descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# 🦞💥 LOBSTER ROLLER 💥🦞  
**The VR game where your HANDS are the wheels.**
💥 Slam your hands down to blast forward  🌀 Drift around corners like a pro  🔋 Charge your boost by taking risky turns  🚀 Then launch past everyone at MAX SPEED    
# 🖐️ YOU = SPEED
[media]
---
# 🛣️ INSANE TRACKS
Try surviving:
⚡ Super tight corners  🦘 Huge jump gaps  🚧 Obstacles that will WRECK you  🤯 Risky shortcuts only the brave take  [media]
---
# 🦞🏁🔥UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE SKINS  
Complete racing challenges and unlock skin rewards!
Will you discover SECRET ones hidden in the world?
[media]

# READY?
# ...SET
# ...ROLL!!!
